paragraphs: LINEV Systems US, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is the exclusive source for LINEV products in the US, Canada, Mexico, and Latin America. The company presents itself as a certified small business working in the security and non-destructive testing industries.

Products on the homepage include X-ray screening systems for people, baggage, cargo and vehicles. One body scanner listed there is described as scanning an inmate from two different angles. Battery sorting systems are listed for recycling lines. A forensic radiography system and benchtop spectrometers for laboratories are listed as well.

The about page states that 98% of clients are City, County, and State Corrections. Case studies on the homepage name county jails, sheriff offices and state corrections departments. Field service is based out of Conroe, Texas, with nine direct field service engineers supporting regional engineers nationally.
